items.title: In war, anything can happen; in investing, only management matters. 6 stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 27%
items.description: Net margin is a useful metric. It tells you how much profit remains after costs, interest, and tax are deducted from revenue. But it does not tell you whether the sector is structurally tough. It does not tell you whether management has pricing discipline. It does not tell you whether the company has survived a crisis that killed competitors. It does not tell you whether the business can reinvest. It does not tell you whether low margin is a weakness or simply the price of operating in a hard but defensible industry. It does not necessarily tell you whether the stock is worth picking up in the market.

items.title: Fed FOMC, Q4 earnings and FII action among 9 factors set to steer D-Street this week
items.description: Markets may remain volatile amid key triggers this week, including the Fed policy decision, Q4 earnings and geopolitical tensions. Technically, Nifty’s near-term bias has turned weak below 23,900, with support at 23,500 and resistance at 24,200–24,500. The rupee logged its steepest weekly fall since September 2022, while Vedanta and Hindustan Zinc will be in focus on key corporate actions.
